remarks: Completely Renovated, clean & bright first floor 2 bedroom apartment on quiet street in the Spring Hill area of Norwalk. Located within walking distance to Norwalk Hospital. Unit includes 2 expansive bedrooms, 1 full bathroom, living room, and kitchen. Coin operated washer/dryer access from outside bilco doors in rear of building. Natural Gas for Heat/Hot Water & Cooking keep utilities LOW! Price includes (2) parking spaces in driveway. Grass area in rear perfect for summer grilling. Property is conveniently located minutes from CT Ave, SONO, South Norwalk Train Station, I95, Rt 7, and many shops/restaurants. You could smell the philly cheese steaks from Blue Cactus Grill it's that close! Tenants must have good credit, proof of income, and references. Pets considered Case by Case Basis. *ONE BEDROOM UNIT 1 SAME UPGRADES ALSO AVAILABLE $2,250/MONTH*
